B2.definition: The art and science of good eating and culinary culture.
B2.example: Lyons is globally celebrated for its rich history of gastronomy.

C1.definition: All the people in a country or area who are entitled to vote in an election.
C1.example: Political analysts observed significant disillusionment among the general electorate following repeated government corruption scandals nationwide.

C2.definition: Attacking or ignoring cherished beliefs, traditional institutions, or established conventions; subversive; differs from rebellious by targeting core beliefs.
C2.example: The artist's iconoclastic exhibition challenged traditional concepts of beauty, sparking intense debate among art critics and traditionalists.
